## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-bugfix`, `area:test`, `mod-frost`.

## Affected area

Tests

## Summary

Eleven `gemm/frost` planning tests fail on any GPU outside SM100–SM119. They check plan-time decisions and do not launch kernels, but two device queries answer first:

- **Swap-AB validation tests.** These are `test_moe_swap_ab_token_quant_requires_aligned_groups` (4 cases), `test_moe_swap_ab_segmented_feature_quant_requires_scale_prefix` and `test_moe_swap_ab_preserves_block_scale_tile_constraints` (2 cases). They expect a specific plan-time decline. The template's active-GPU gate rejects first with "template sm100_moe_grouped_matmul_fwd_swap_ab.py runs only on 100 <= SM < 120, but the active GPU is sm_89", so the `match=` fails. They now plan on the SM100 compiler, which a new `plan_as_sm100(monkeypatch)` in `gemm_test_utils` returns after pinning the arch probe to 100 on it and on the active family's compiler (the one the template gate reads); the other planning tests in this directory pin the arch the same way (31 `_current_arch` pins under `test/python/gemm/frost`). The SM100 compiler is named explicitly because on SM120 `cudnn.gemm.frost.compiler` is the sm120 tree.
- **`test_block_scale_sf_ring_budget` (4 cases).** It already pinned the arch and now plans on the SM100 compiler through the same helper. But rendering the 2-CTA config sizes the grid from `cudnn.frost.occupancy.max_active_clusters`, which queries the active GPU. A GPU without clusters raises "a 2-CTA cluster does not fit on cuda:0". The test checks the AB stage count, which does not depend on the cluster count, so it stubs `_grid_num_clusters`.

No product code changes.

## Why

Running the gemm suite on a non-Blackwell GPU (here an L40S, while validating other work) reported these as failures, although no kernel was involved.

## Related issues

None found.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Test only.

## Testing

L40S (cc 8.9), develop `cdbf76d0` (the extension built from `fb1d3bf8`; nothing outside Python and docs changed in between), torch 2.14.1+cu130, cuDNN 9.27.0, CuTe DSL 4.8.1, `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`, run from `test/python`:

| Command | develop | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `python -m pytest -m L0 -k "sf_ring_budget or swap_ab_preserves_block_scale_tile_constraints or swap_ab_token_quant_requires_aligned_groups or swap_ab_segmented_feature_quant_requires_scale_prefix" gemm/frost/test_block_scale_matmul.py gemm/frost/test_moe_grouped_block_scale_matmul_fwd.py gemm/frost/test_moe_grouped_matmul_fwd.py` | 15 passed, **11 failed** | 26 passed |

The whole `gemm` directory at L0 on develop `fa065f1e` on the same GPU: 2841 passed, 13879 skipped, 11 failed. Those 11 are the cases above.

GH200 (cc 9.0), same selector, previous head `c7184f0c` / this branch `4d58fa90`: 26 passed / 26 passed. With `CUDNN_FRONTEND_GEMM_ARCH_FAMILY=sm120`, which makes `cudnn.gemm.frost.compiler` the sm120 tree as on an SM120 GPU: `c7184f0c` 5 passed, **3 failed**, 18 skipped (the same as a reviewer's RTX 5080 run: both CTA-N cases and the zero-stage SF-ring case); `4d58fa90` 18 passed, 8 skipped (the 8 are two sibling SF-ring tests this PR does not touch). Not run on a real SM120 GPU.

detail.title: test(gemm): keep the FROST planning tests independent of the active GPU

files.patch:
@@ -52,6 +52,21 @@ def with_static_segmented_capacity(live: torch.Tensor, total_rows: int, num_grou
     return result
 
 
+def plan_as_sm100(monkeypatch):
+    """The SM100 compiler, for planning-only checks of SM100 configs on any GPU.
+
+    Its arch probe and the active family's compiler's (the template gate reads that
+    one) are pinned to SM100, so the active GPU's own gate does not answer first. On
+    SM120 the active family is the sm120 tree, so the SM100 compiler is named
+    explicitly rather than reached through ``cudnn.gemm.frost.compiler``."""
+    from cudnn.gemm.frost import compiler as active
+    from cudnn.gemm.frost.sm100 import compiler as sm100
+
+    for module in {id(sm100): sm100, id(active): active}.values():
+        monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_current_arch", lambda device=None: 100)
+    return sm100
+
